Items.Source: Degrees lock to lock sent to a Logitech wheel, which powers up at 200, and the range the spring’s angles are counted against. Sent while this tab drives the wheel: Enable on the Force Feedback page, or Centering spring. Leave as it is sends nothing, and is for a wheel without the centering spring: ticking the spring picks 900. Any other wheel turns the range its own software sets; the page then says so, and a formula in the steering box, such as =a1*900/270, steers a shorter range.
